title: hex puzzle game
author: Inside_Sea_9521
selftext: Hey everyone! I just released a new puzzle game on Unity Play: HexaJump! **It’s a strategic, hexagonal jumping brain-teaser where every move counts!** Your Goal: **Guide the** Green piece **to the** Gold goal tile**!** How to Play: **• Select your Green or Blue pieces and jump over adjacent tiles (Black pegs, Blue friends, or portals) into empty spaces. • Watch out for** Red blockers **you can't jump over! • Step into** numbered purple portals **to warp across the board!** Play directly in your browser here:\*\* [browser game](https://play.unity.com/en/games/08b26c3d-1ec2-4b94-a216-69473fe49234/build) Stuck on a tricky level? Check out the full walkthrough & solutions video here: [youtube solutions](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gcOnwIOkOa0&t=13s) Give it a spin and let me know what you think and which level gave you the hardest time!
